mainEntity.name: How do I plan the order of kitchen appliance placement so the layout actually works day to day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with the **big appliances** first: refrigerator, sink, dishwasher, and range. A good layout keeps them in a practical work triangle, with enough counter space for landing and prep between each stop, so you are not crossing the room while cooking or unloading groceries.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan the fridge, sink, dishwasher, and range first, then build counter space and cabinet storage around how you cook and clean. The goal is a smooth work triangle with enough landing space between stations.
